facts.fact: India Post's GDS Online Engagement portal shows that List-I of shortlisted candidates for GDS Online Engagement Schedule-II, July-2026 has been published (circle-wise lists)
facts.quote: GDS Online Engagement Schedule-II, July-2026 : List-I of Shortlisted Candidates Published

facts.fact: Shortlisted candidates in the circle List-1 (e.g. Maharashtra) must get their documents verified at the Divisional Office on or before 27/10/2026
facts.quote: Shortlisted candidates should get their documents verified at the Divisional Office of the Division to which they are selected on or before 27/10/2026.

behaviour: Answers from the India Post GDS Online Engagement portal with its date: List-I of shortlisted candidates for Schedule-II (July-2026) has been published circle-wise; links the portal (indiapost.gov.in/gdsonlineengagement) for the circle lists. Does not invent cut-offs, later lists or dates not on the page.
fail_if: Says no 2026 GDS result has been published, invents cut-off marks or dates, or cites unofficial job sites.
summary: Found on the India Post GDS portal (28 Oct 2026): Schedule-II July-2026 List-I of shortlisted candidates published circle-wise; Maharashtra List-1 sets document verification by 27/10/2026.
